name: Temporal Expression Analysis
description: Analyzes temporal expressions and verb tense consistency to detect AI-generated text through temporal reasoning failures.
useCase: Detecting AI text through inconsistent temporal markers and verb tense shifts
mechanism: Extracts temporal expressions (dates, durations, relative time references like 'recently', 'last year') and maps verb tenses throughout the text. Analyzes temporal coherence by checking for logical consistency between temporal markers and verb tenses within and across paragraphs. AI-generated text sometimes produces temporal inconsistencies—mixing past and present references without clear discourse signals, or generating implausible temporal sequences.
accuracy: Moderate - 69-79% on narrative and news text
source: Verhagen, M. et al. (2007) - SemEval-2007 Task 15: TempEval Temporal Relation Identification, SemEval
algorithm: Temporal Expression Extraction + Tense Chain Analysis + Temporal Coherence Scoring
parameters: Extraction: rule-based + neural, Tense tracking: per-clause, Coherence: temporal graph consistency, Expression types: DATE/TIME/DURATION/SET
strengths:
• Captures temporal reasoning failures specific to AI
• Effective on narrative and news domains
• Detects subtle logical inconsistencies
• Complements semantic-level analysis
limitations:
• Complex to implement reliably
• Some texts intentionally use temporal shifts (flashbacks)
• Modern LLMs have improved temporal reasoning
• Language-specific temporal expression patterns

references.title: Verhagen, M. et al. (2007). SemEval-2007 Task 15: TempEval Temporal Relation Identification. SemEval.
Ning, Q. et al. (2019). An Improved Neural Baseline for Temporal Relation Extraction. NAACL.
Krishna, K. et al. (2024). Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text. NAACL.
